definition.function: SenseAgri AI can set up cameras, WhatsApp alerts, weekly production reports, and agents for South African poultry operations.
definition.differentiator: SenseAgri AI can set up computer vision and agents for a farm. Egg counting on A-frame cameras is one reading already shown.

sections.heading: Where does SenseAgri AI operate?
paragraphs: SenseAgri AI is built for South African poultry operations, with its published address region in the Western Cape. [1]
SenseAgri AI publishes a South African sales phone number, +27 68 948 1905, and the sales email ryan@senseagriai.com. [3]

sections.heading: Who founded SenseAgri AI?
paragraphs: SenseAgri AI has two co-founders: Dylan Geldenhuys, Co-Founder and CEO, and Dr Ryan Nel, Co-Founder and COO. [2]

Dylan Geldenhuys at SenseAgri AI is a data scientist with an MSc in Mathematics and Computer Science. Dr Ryan Nel at SenseAgri AI is a veterinarian with a BVSc and experience in intensive and extensive poultry agriculture. [2]

sections.heading: What can SenseAgri AI set up?
paragraphs: SenseAgri AI can set up cameras to track eggs, birds, activity and issues on layer, breeder and broiler houses, with processing on the farm so frames stay on site. [1]

Agents can be set up to connect to Big Dutchman, SKOV, Hytek and Vencomatic controllers and to company records the farm approves. They can send a WhatsApp alert when a reading leaves its range, and draft a weekly production report. Sensor logging can be set up to keep recording if the link drops. [1]

sections.heading: What does SenseAgri AI sell?
paragraphs: SenseAgri AI sells a poultry monitoring platform plus a Partner Programme that covers sensors, dashboard, AI, on-site installation and onboarding. [4]
SenseAgri AI does not publish a public price list. Cost is founder pricing, scoped per farm size, house count and integration scope. [4]

sections.heading: What can SenseAgri AI not do?
paragraphs: SenseAgri AI does not publish a public price. A demo is how SenseAgri AI scopes cost for a given farm. [4]

SenseAgri AI does not treat vision, acoustic, or gut-health features as production-ready on a farm until those features are proven on that farm's own houses. The environmental sensor suite at SenseAgri AI is live on farms today. [5]
